title: Presence, Product Context, Mobile UX & State Migration
selected_by_owner: Strict successor after owner-approved PCV-03 decomposition and PCV-03D completed_verified closeout.
objective: Advisory presence and remote Campaign continuity integrate into the ordinary product safely on phone/desktop, and unsafe pre-audit PCV-03 persisted state is retired/migrated without inheriting stale authority or secrets.
acceptance: Presence is derived from the bound connection lifecycle and host time, never caller-supplied identity/authority.
Disconnect/reconnect updates advisory presence correctly while leaving membership authority separate.
Remote joined Campaign/Session continuity is represented as a role-safe local product context/cache without copying host authoritative Campaign truth into the player owner store.
Continuity keys support multiple Campaign/Session identities for one subject without collision.
Invitation/join/presence/reconnect controls pass phone-responsive, keyboard and nonvisual/accessibility checks.
Retire/quarantine pre-audit PCV-03.session.1 records and revoke old invitation/resume credentials; do not silently promote unsafe old records into the repaired authority model.
Strip or route unrelated presentation/skin changes out of the PCV-03 authority candidate.
PCV-03F and PCV-04 remain unauthorized until this item closes.
boundaries: Preserve PCV-03A identity/invitation and Campaign membership authority, PCV-03B canonical Session lifecycle/authority epoch, PCV-03C peer-bound transport and PCV-03D one-history delivery/recovery; PCV-03E consumes those owners rather than replacing them.
Presence is advisory only, derived from bound connection lifecycle and host-authoritative time; caller-supplied identity, role, presence or connection claims never become authority.

Remote joined Campaign/Session continuity returns through the A3 AuthorizedDashboardProjection -> AuthorizedContextProjection / SelectedContextReceipt boundary plus current A5 membership/Session state; do not copy host ownership or canonical Campaign truth into the player owner store.

ProductSelectedContext may persist only safe projected ids/labels. Protected caches, subscriptions and recovery projections remain subject+context partitioned and are cleared before use after context switch, sign-out, membership removal, permission drift or revocation.
Continuity keys must distinguish multiple Campaign/Session identities for one subject without collision.

Invitation, join, presence and reconnect controls must remain phone-usable and keyboard/touch/nonvisual accessible; preserve 44 CSS px targets, logical focus, 200% font scaling and explicit user-invoked handling for sensitive signaling text.

Quarantine/retire unsafe pre-audit PCV-03.session.1 state and revoke legacy invitation/resume credentials. Never silently promote stale authority, secrets or recovery metadata into the repaired model.
Do not absorb unrelated presentation/skin/global-shell redesign into this authority tranche; route such work to the current UI/UISK owners.
Do not build or certify installed packages in PCV-03E. PCV-03F remains the exact-head installed Windows/Android certification tranche.
Do not implement PCV-04 gameplay/action/combat authority.
Use milestone-level OPS3 state only; no activity-journal instrumentation.
